result.title: NV-Generate-Body: 3D Latent Diffusion Model forControllable Anatomy, Tumor, and Demographic Body Mask Synthesis
result.summary: Curating large labeled CT datasets is expensive and constrained by patient privacy. We present NV-Generate-BodyMask, a 3D latent diffusion model that synthesizes whole-body CT segmentation masks with precise, joint control over organ anatomy, tumor burden, and patient demographics. The model operates in the compressed latent space of a frozen mask autoencoder, generating $256^3$ volumetric label maps conditioned on a 19-dimensional vector via Adaptive Group Normalization and cross-attention. A size-adaptive ROI loss with spatial halo weighting and a paired tumor injection pipeline enable accurate tumor size conditioning despite the scarcity of annotated tumor cases. Trained on 8,571 masks across 26 cohorts spanning 132 labels, the model achieves Spearman $ρ= 0.70$--$0.92$ for organ size, 85--100\% tumor recall for lung, pancreatic, colon, and bone lesions, and strong demographic alignment (BMI $ρ= 0.78$, sex-conditioned perfect prostate control).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NV-Generate-BodyMask，一个在冻结掩码自编码器潜空间中运行的 3D 潜扩散模型，用于按器官解剖、肿瘤负荷和人口学属性联合控制的全身 CT 分割掩码合成。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽含「latent diffusion」字样，但潜空间仅用于医学图像生成与条件控制，不涉及视觉推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可借鉴的状态或训练线索。
